leadText:
Wish is the ending theme for the Korean dub of Mewtwo's Counterattack EVOLUTION. It is performed by Kwon Haneul.

A special MV for the song, featuring winning entries from the Pokémon Movie Art Contest, was released on the official Korean YouTube channel on October 5, 2020.
plainText:
Wish is the ending theme for the Korean dub of Mewtwo's Counterattack EVOLUTION. It is performed by Kwon Haneul.

A special MV for the song, featuring winning entries from the Pokémon Movie Art Contest, was released on the official Korean YouTube channel on October 5, 2020.

==Lyrics==
 
! Korean
! English

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

Embracing the faint aroma from my memories
The times you and I walked together
Unexpectedly arise in my mind

The sky that dazzled brightly even in my dreams
Can I fly to it like the wind?

Become the wind and pass over the high mountains
Fly to the end of the swaying seas
The beautiful world I'd always dreamt of
You and I will go together
Become the wind

I always gazed at the starlight of the night sky
Embracing the wind cherished inside my heart
When the dark night passes, the sun
Rises again

The sky that dazzled brightly even in my dreams
Can I fly to it like the wind?

Become the wind and pass over the high mountains
Fly to the end of the swaying seas
The beautiful world I'd always dreamt of
You and I will go together

Woo woo
Woo woo
Following the continuing road
Passing through the forest spread afar
To the place where our dreams lie

Become the wind and pass over the high mountains
Fly to the end of the swaying seas
The beautiful world I'd always dreamt of
You and I will go together
Become the wind
